name: Flashcards
how_it_works: Flip card: characters + audio ↔ English (no pinyin). Kid self-marks "knew it"/"not yet"

name: Listen and pick
how_it_works: Audio plays; tap the English (R-ZE) or the Chinese for an English prompt (R-EZ)

name: Say it
how_it_works: See English (+ picture), say the Chinese (S-EZ); or hear Chinese, say the English (S-ZE)

name: Matching game
how_it_works: Match 6 Chinese cards to 6 English cards (timer-free)

name: Quick quiz
how_it_works: 10 mixed questions picked by the engine (weakest way first), same grading as battle
